snippet.title: PuppetShow: The Face of Humanity Playthrough Part 1
snippet.description:
This is part one of a playthrough of PuppetShow: The Face of Humanity from Big Fish Games.There is no commentary, and you can use it as a visual strategy guide, or just watch it for fun!

Game available at: http://www.bigfishgames.com/games/11366/puppetshow-the-face-of-humanity-ce/?pc

Tumblr: http://nazzycat.tumblr.com/
